rent.note: furnished 1BR condo near the beach/centre, ~20,000 THB at 33.56 THB/USD. FazWaz 1BR avg $630 (661 listings); blog range 15-25k THB; DDproperty's first page (new projects) 16-40k

groceries.note: home cooking; split from 9,000-13,000 THB/mo food budgets

diningOut.note: street food 50-70 THB, Thai restaurant mains ~150 THB, some Western meals; food total ~$300

transit.note: monthly motorbike 3,000-4,000 THB or songthaews (10-20 THB a ride) plus occasional Grab/Bolt

coworking.note: few dedicated spaces and no stable published monthly price found; ~4,700 THB assumed, between Phuket's ~3,850 THB and nomads.com's $249 crowd figure

simData.note: Thai prepaid: dtac 10GB/30 days 214 THB incl. VAT; ~400 THB for a larger allowance

accomSeasonality._doc: Rent-only multipliers Jan..Dec. Snowbird high season Nov-Feb (peak Dec-Feb, into March); low season May-Oct is the time to negotiate long leases (iamkohchang.com). Milder swing than Phuket because of year-round Bangkok weekend demand.
